overall_goal: Prepare the chicken marinade by adding chicken and all ingredients into a bowl

goals.description: Get the bowl and open the chicken container
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a bowl and opens the plastic container of chicken to prepare for washing and marinating.

goals.description: Separate, wash, and place the first batch of chicken pieces into the bowl
goals.rationale: The person pulls out the first frozen chicken pieces, rinses them under the tap to separate them, and places them into the bowl.

goals.description: Separate, wash, and place the remaining chicken pieces into the bowl
goals.rationale: The person continues to separate the rest of the frozen chicken pieces under running water, places them in the bowl, and distributes them.
The person retrieves a bottle of vinegar and repeatedly uses its lid to measure and sprinkle vinegar over the chicken.

goals.description: Retrieve lemon and soy sauce, and pour soy sauce into the bowl
goals.rationale: The person gathers lemons and soy sauce from the fridge and cupboard, then pours soy sauce directly into the bowl.

goals.description: Squeeze the first lemon into the bowl and remove fallen seeds
goals.rationale: The person uses a squeezer to extract juice from lemon halves into the bowl, pausing to remove a seed that accidentally fell in.

goals.description: Cut and squeeze another lemon into the bowl
goals.rationale: The person cuts a fresh lemon in half and squeezes its juice into the bowl using the lemon squeezer.
The person opens a package of rosemary with scissors and repeatedly adds strands of rosemary to the chicken.

goals.description: Add oregano and spice mix to the bowl
goals.rationale: The person selects jars of oregano and spice mix from the cupboard and sprinkles them into the marinade.

goals.description: Break the garlic head and peel the outer cover
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a head of garlic, breaks it apart to separate the cloves, removes the outer skin, and discards the waste.

goals.description: Peel and chop the garlic cloves into the bowl
goals.rationale: The person peels individual garlic cloves with a knife and chops them directly into the bowl to complete the marinade.
